title: How Hate Speech Varies by Target Identity: A Computational Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-identity generalization of hate speech classifiers trained on specific racial and ethnic target groups, and analyzing lexical variation using Sparse Additive Generative Models (SAGE).
Evaluating cross-identity generalization of hate speech classifiers trained on specific targeted religious groups, and analyzing lexical variation using Sparse Additive Generative Models (SAGE).

Evaluating cross-identity generalization of hate speech classifiers trained on specific gender and sexual orientation targets, and analyzing lexical variation using Sparse Additive Generative Models (SAGE).

Comparing hate speech classification performance and language variation between socially dominant and marginalized identity groups, including testing the effects of removing hate speech directed at dominant groups from the training data.
